| Dimension | Assessment |
|-----------|------------|
| **Cross-cultural friendliness** | High |
| **Non-Western epistemology openness** | Medium |

| **Dominant theoretical tradition** | Interdisciplinary cognitive science — cognitive modeling, language processing, reasoning, learning, perception-action, integrating psychology / linguistics / CS / philosophy / neuroscience |

### Framing Requirements

- **Mandatory framing?** Yes (strong)
- **If yes, what kind?** Manuscripts must demonstrate **interdisciplinary cognitive-science contribution** bridging at least two of psychology / linguistics / CS / philosophy / neuroscience. Mono-disciplinary work redirected.
- **Consequences of ignoring it**: Mono-disciplinary cognitive-psychology work redirected to JEP titles or Cognition; pure CS / linguistics work redirected to specialist venues.

## Strategic Notes

### Hard Blockers

- Mono-disciplinary work without interdisciplinary cognitive-science contribution
- AI use without disclosure per Wiley policy
- Theoretical work without computational implementation or empirical link

### Soft Tax

Low for cognitive-science tradition authors. Interdisciplinary breadth demands articulation of contribution across subfields.

### Best Suited For

- Cognitive modeling research bridging multiple subfields
- Language processing with computational + psychological insight
- Reasoning and problem-solving studies
- Cognitive development with computational framing
- Connectionist / symbolic AI cognitive contributions
- Cog Sci Society annual conference paper extensions

### Not Recommended For

- Pure psychology cognitive work (consider JEP titles, Cognition)
- Pure CS / linguistics / philosophy (consider specialty venues)
- Pure qualitative work
- Applied cognition (consider JEP:Applied)

### Rejection Fallback Chain

| Rank | Journal | Why this fallback works |
|------|---------|------------------------|
| 1 | [Cognition](./cognition.md) | Elsevier peer; cognitive theoretical advance |
| 2 | [Cognitive Psychology](./cognitive-psychology.md) | Elsevier peer; theoretical-empirical long-form |
| 3 | [Trends in Cognitive Sciences](./trends-in-cognitive-sciences.md) | If reframed as theoretical synthesis (invited / pre-submission proposal) |

**Reverse direction** *(optional)*: If your paper was rejected from a single-discipline venue as "too interdisciplinary," Cognitive Science is the native interdisciplinary home — Cog Sci Society audience expects cross-subfield integration.
